spec: Default product bar: logo, links grouped beside it, actions pushed right. 64 to 68px tall, 14 to 16px links at 400 to 500, each 36px tall with 12px padding, 1px rule at 8 to 10 percent ink. Right: 36px ghost plus solid CTA, radius 6 to 10, gutters on the page rail.

Logo left, links truly centred with a 1fr auto 1fr grid, actions right. 52 to 72px tall, 14 to 16px links, 24 to 40px gaps, tiny 8 to 10px chevrons only on items that open. Bar can match the page colour with no border. One or two 28 to 40px actions.

Logo alone at left, all links pushed right beside the action, which reads calm and confident. 64 to 88px tall, 13 to 16px muted links, 24 to 32px apart, a 1x14px divider before Log in, one 32 to 40px pill. Gutter equals the hero's left edge.

Compact global bar: 44px tall, 12px links at 80 percent ink spread evenly across a fixed 980px row with space-between, mark far left, search and bag far right, no CTA. Use saturate(1.8) blur(20px) on an 80 percent fill so colour tints it as content passes.

Wordmark dead centre on a 1fr auto 1fr grid, categories left, utilities right. 56 to 72px tall, 12 to 13px tracked caps or 16px text, 25px gaps, 10 to 24px side inset, no filled CTA or one 32px outlined pill. For retail, hospitality and food.

Three points: menu word with two-line icon at left, centred wordmark, one booking action at right. 56 to 73px tall, 14px labels, action a 42 to 50px near-square block or bold text. No link row. For hotels, restaurants and luxury, where the one decision is to book.

Logo left, then only the word Menu, a burger or one action at right, with no exposed links. No fill or border, 20 to 40px gutters, 14 to 17px labels. Use when the site has few pages or the work should fill the screen. Give the menu word a 44px target.

No bar: a line of small type floats on the page. 11 to 14px, caps tracked .08em or plain text, 35 to 56px gaps, no fill, border or button. Also works at display scale, 35 to 44px, as the header itself. Needs a quiet ground or a top scrim on images.

No bar: fixed items pinned to viewport corners at 16 to 32px insets, 11 to 16px type, content scrolling freely beneath. Logo in one corner, Contact in another, perhaps a clock or toggle. For portfolios and studios. Check every corner against every section for contrast.

Fixed transparent row set white with mix-blend-mode:difference, so each letter inverts over what passes beneath. 12 to 17px text, 15 to 32px margins, no fill. Keep grounds near white or near black, because mid greys and saturated colours turn muddy.

No fill or border: a 72px fixed bar over a 16 to 20px blur masked to fade out 30 to 130px below it. Links 14 to 15px. Nothing guarantees contrast, so flip ink and CTA per section by sampling what sits under the bar, with a 200ms transition.

One bar geometry, skin swapped per section: fill, links, CTA and rule change as sections pass, in 200ms. Either match the section colour so the bar melts into it, or invert on dark chapters. Mark sections with a data attribute and sample under the bar.

Starts clear over hero media with white links, becomes solid or blurred past 40px of scroll. 64 to 96px shrinking to 64 to 72px, 200 to 300ms on background and colour. Add a 1px rule or soft shadow only in the solid state. Logo and CTA swap colour with it.

Global bar plus a product row. Global 44 to 76px scrolls away, then a 44 to 66px row sticks: product name left at 15 to 21px, anchors right at 12 to 15px, current in ink, rest muted or accent, CTA at the end, blur or dashed rule between tiers.

Two stacked rows: a 24 to 64px utility or brand row over a 44 to 90px section row. Utility 10 to 13px, sections 14 to 18px, 1px rules between. For institutions, retail and magazines with many audiences. Keep both rows on the same page rails.

The bar changes job on scroll: full links at top, then only logo and CTA, or section anchors with an active state and a 2 to 3px progress line along the top edge. 56 to 72px, soft shadow, 200 to 300ms crossfade. For long pricing and product pages.

Search outranks links: a 36 to 48px field, 190 to 780px wide, filled or 1px outlined, with a keycap hint, sits centre or after the logo. 48 to 70px bar, 14px links, small icon tools. For docs, marketplaces and registries. Must be working search.

Shop bar: many plain categories, 11 to 16px, 20 to 40px apart, then an underlined search field or icon, account and bag with a count. 56 to 80px tall, no CTA because the categories are the action, one category in red or bold for sale. Dense but flat.

A developer's bar: 13 to 15px mono links, often caps, in a 56 to 64px bar on the page column, hairline below, radius 4. Actions show 16px keycaps beside search, sign up and download, or links take slash prefixes or bracket indices. Every control hints at a shortcut.

The nav is a table: cells split by 1px rules, logo in its own cell, links in equal cells of 100 to 240px, sometimes an inverted end cap for sign in. 44 to 112px tall, 12 to 16px mono or grotesk, radius 0 to 4. For archives, institutions and technical brands.

Links as objects: each a 28 to 40px chip or tag, radius 3 to 999, tinted or white with a 1px edge, 2 to 10px gaps, sometimes grouped in one capsule. Active chip one tone darker. Works over photographs with no bar behind, and can flank a centred logo.

The whole bar is the brand colour: 48 to 72px flat fill, no border, links in one ink at 14 to 16px, often lowercase or caps, one contrasting action. Makes the top edge the identity. Confirm 4.5:1 for links and repeat that colour lower on the page.

Always-open site map: 3 or 4 columns of two or three 13px links on 18px leading, no fill, aligned to the footer grid, or pictured items with a line glyph and sub-links. 80 to 100px tall, scrolls away. For small catalogues with few destinations.

Nav on the viewport's bottom edge: 42 to 54px strip, 11 to 15px links, name at one end, the key action at the other. For single-screen sites and local services, where call or book stays under the thumb. Add safe-area padding on phones.

The bar's main control is a switch of audience, product, category or filter: a 44px tinted track with an active pill, three to five icon tabs with an underline, or five evenly spaced 12px filters beside search. Use when the first decision is who you are or what you want.

The bar imitates an operating system or live instrument: 36 to 44px, inset 8px at radius 6 like a menu bar, or icon cells split by rules, or a live clock and online count in mono. Only when the whole site commits to that metaphor.

Something hangs off the top edge: links in a dark tab about 640x46 with concave corners cut into the page, a round seal overhanging the row, a half-disc crest, or a tiled frieze. One shaped object gives identity without adding chrome.

Fixed bar inset 8 to 24px from the top and 8 to 60px at the sides, 60 to 76px tall, radius 12 to 20, fill at 72 to 85 percent with 12 to 20px blur, 1px ring at 8 percent. 14 to 15px links, 36px CTA inset 8 to 14px from the end.

At top a transparent full-width row. Past 40px of scroll it draws in to a 980 to 1380px capsule, 16 to 25px from the top, 54 to 64px tall, radius 27 to 100, 70 to 80 percent fill, 20px blur, soft shadow. Animate max-width 450ms, fill 250ms.

Small pill at top centre, 40 to 58px tall, 420 to 680px wide, full radius, 12 to 24px from the top: logo, 12 to 15px links, inset 32 to 36px CTA. White with soft shadow, or translucent with blur. Four links at most. The logo can stay outside it.

Precise rather than cute: a tray 450 to 1100px wide, 56 to 76px tall, radius 3 to 8, 1px hairline, flat or 50 to 60 percent fill with blur, no shadow. The logo can sit centre between two words. Reads as a label on a technical drawing.

Nav as a segmented control: fixed 480x40 near-ink bar, radius 8, 2px padding, five 94px segments with 1px gaps, active segment a paper tile at radius 6. The thumb slides on scroll-spy. Legible over any section. For one-page sites with five sections or fewer.

No bar: logo and action become separate floating objects in opposite corners, 12 to 40px from the edges. A 48 to 52px white circle mark collapses from the wordmark, a 40 to 48px action pill opposite, soft shadow. Nothing between them, so sections keep full width.

Two separate bars side by side: a long nav bar and a short actions bar, 60px tall, inset 16px, radius 8, 6px gap, sometimes joined by a short coloured dash. The gap is the identity. Use with a strong grid and one small accent.

A floating element for sections: centred row of 36px pills, 14px text, 18px gaps, solid current pill, in a frosted band; or a white 64px card 8px from the top holding anchors and a CTA after the global bar leaves. Sticks under the page's own chrome.

Fixed pill at bottom centre, 480x52, 18px above the edge: name, 14px links, toggle, translucent so each panel tints it. Reserve a safe zone so it never covers CTAs or copy. For portfolios. On phones it competes with browser chrome.

One action follows the reader: a bottom-centre 480 to 510px prompt field, 48 to 56px tall, with a 32px accent button, or a 224x60 pill with a founder's photo, or a small chip 20 to 24px from a corner. Only when the action is the product.

Compact lozenge: 240 to 380px wide, 40 to 52px tall, radius 6 to 12, fixed at top centre, holding mark, wordmark and a two-line menu icon, perhaps a clock. No links exposed, so sections keep full width. The menu opens from it.

Expressive capsule with visible construction: black 82px bar, radius 40, dashed vertical seams dividing logo, links and CTAs like a ticket stub, or a 2px outlined capsule with a ringed burger overlapping its end. Only on expressive consumer pages.

One line on near-black above the nav: 38 to 48px, 14px/500 white, centred, an arrow that moves 3px on hover or an underlined link, optional close 24px from the right. Ties to dark CTAs. Truncate with an ellipsis on phones rather than wrapping.

Strip sits behind the page: a fixed 44 to 76px band with the page sheet above it at 24 to 40px rounded top corners, so the site looks lifted. 14 to 16px text, one 32px white pill. Keep sheet and nav the same colour.

A deep tone of the brand rather than its full colour: 36 to 65px, oxblood from a red CTA or teal-black from a cyan one, 14 to 16px cream or tinted text, small coloured arrow. Reads as brand, not warning. One step off a dark page is enough.

Saturated brand colour, 32 to 60px, ink or white 14 to 16px text, one arrow or pill. Works when it is the only bright colour on the first screen. Keep it above 30px with 12px minimum text, because 9px caps on an 18px strip looks like a template.

Quiet tint with ink text: 34 to 48px, 3 to 8 percent of a hue, 14px centred, underlined link, close at right, optional 1px rule. News without urgency. Use when the page already has strong colour below.

A small tag starts the line: an 18 to 28px pill or outlined label at 11 to 12px saying what kind of news this is, then a 14px sentence and underlined link. The tag can be the only accent. Aligns left to the logo or centres in a 34 to 60px strip.

Texture at the ends, text in the middle: a 36 to 52px strip with halftone dots shrinking inward over 230 to 300px, brand grain, or a 2px gradient hairline at the base. A real material, not a flat fill. Dots must shrink, because a uniform grid looks like a bug.

Not full-bleed: a 32 to 62px notice inset to the page container, radius 4 to 12, tinted, or white on a tinted page, 14px centred line, close at right. Reads as a card above the hero. Keep its edges on the page rail.

News under the nav rather than above it: 38 to 52px, page tint or hairlines only, 14px centred, bold underlined link. Scrolls away while the nav stays. Keeps the top edge clean. Mono caps reads as machine output.

Not a bar: a 24 to 36px pill 24px above the H1, full radius, tinted or 1px edge, 13px text, small dot or arrow. Stays on the hero's axis. Common to the point of cliche, so use it only for real news with a date or a name.

Continuous loop of offers: 16 to 56px strip, 12 to 14px mono or caps, 24 to 48px gaps, separators, faded right edge, pause button at right. Reads as ticker tape. Must pause on hover and stop under reduced motion.

Two to four offers in one slot: 28 to 46px, 11 to 14px centred, thin chevrons at both ends, or a vertical crossfade every 5 to 7 seconds. Keep the paging controls, because auto-rotation alone hides offers.

A strip that also carries utilities: loyalty or store links left, centred offer, region right, 32 to 52px, 11 to 14px. Folds chrome into one line so the main nav holds only products. Region switchers add a flag select and a round arrow.

Pinned to the viewport base: 42 to 60px, one offer or question left, action and close right, 1px top rule or solid fill, appearing after first scroll. Move it to the top on phones to avoid the browser bar.

A statement, not a promo: availability or a notice in the site's own voice, 44 to 52px, left aligned, closed by a 1px rule; or a filled alert with icon and close when it is truly urgent. No arrow and no offer.

Page-wide band flush under the bar, same colour as the bar, hairline base, no shadow or radius. Three to five text columns from the logo's left edge at 266px steps: 14px grey label over 20px links on 32px pitch, or 14 to 16px on 28px. Page veiled 60 percent.

Full-width sheet growing from a 44px bar, 480 to 530px tall: one large list at 24/600 on 38px pitch, then two small columns at 12/600 on 24px, 12px grey labels, all on the 980px rail. Page behind takes a 20px blur plus a dark veil.

Floating 530 to 900px panel, radius 4 to 12, 1px edge: three or four plain link columns split by vertical hairlines, 12px grey or mono labels, 15px links on 32 to 39px pitch, no icons. Optional 53px tinted footer strip with small 30px pill buttons.

Titles with grey lines and no icons: 800 to 1200px panel, radius 12, 14 to 15px title over a 12 to 14px grey description, three to six columns under small labels, 50 to 60px pitch. Use when names alone do not explain the product.

The common product menu: 560 to 900px panel, radius 8 to 12, rows of a 28 to 32px icon tile, 14px title and 12 to 13px grey one-liner, two or three columns, 50 to 60px pitch, mono or caps labels. Every icon different, all one stroke weight.

Panel 700 to 1000px wide: about six rows of icon, title and one-liner on 60px pitch, then one or two feature tiles 300 to 400px wide, radius 8, showing real product, a graphic or a release. The tile is the only loud thing. Rotate it with news.

Entries are pictures: 830 to 1160px panel, radius 12 to 20, three to five equal cards, 200x133 photos at radius 8 or 254px tinted illustration tiles, 32px gaps, 15px title, 13px line, 49px footer strip. Needs real imagery, because gradients read as placeholders.

Store drawer: full width, 400 to 520px tall, four or five link columns, 12px mono or caps headers, 16px links on 33px pitch, two or three portrait photos 210x263 with captions at right, page blurred and dimmed. First column holds edits and new arrivals.

Left rail of 5 to 8 categories, 36px rows, 200px wide, active pill. Hovering swaps the middle list of title and line on 62px pitch, plus a 240x434 portrait at right. Panel keeps one width across triggers, so nothing jumps. For broad catalogues and industries.

Full-width panel of bordered tiles: one dark lead tile 280px wide holding an overview and two rows, then a 2x3 grid of 480x76 cells, 8px gaps, square corners, 1px line, title and grey line left, small glyph right. Reads as a control panel.

Zones by tone, not lines: 860 to 1000px panel, radius 14 to 20, 8px padding, inner well one tone step off at radius 8 to 16, or a tinted right rail, with a footer strip beneath. Three columns of about 280px with hairlines between; rail holds secondary links.

Small honest menu: 120 to 300px wide, radius 4 to 12, 6 to 10px under the trigger and left-aligned to it, soft shadow, 14px rows on 30 to 34px pitch, plain links or 16px icons. Right for four to eight items. Never stretch it to fill.

Bar and menu are one object: the bar sits inside a panel that opens to about 1262x780, radius 6, big soft shadow, page blurred. Five columns, hairline-ruled 14px headings, accent link over grey line, tinted right rail, footer row. Or the whole bar floods into a sheet.

The menu shows a live thing: an upcoming event card with avatar, date and join button, a changelog feed with thumbnails, blog titles with excerpts, or a product with price and shop button. Use when fresh content beats a list of pages.

No panel: a plain list appears on the hero under the trigger, or a stack of 44px black chips with 4px gaps, or the page swaps to a field of names. Fades and rises 8px. Only over calm images and with few items.

Full-height sheet: 4 to 6 rows at 16 to 18px on 48 to 76px pitch, hairlines between, plus or chevron at right on groups, plain rows below, two CTAs pinned at the base. Rows stagger 45ms and settle by 320 to 900ms. The default for products.

Full screen, 4 to 8 rows at 16 to 20px on 44 to 57px pitch, hairlines, no CTA inside because one stays in the bar, chevrons only on groups. Fast and honest, appears in one step. Put something at the base so it does not look empty.

No accordions, everything visible at once under small grey labels: 14px labels, 24/500 links on 44px pitch, group gaps 28 to 40px, sheet scrolls past the fold. Near instant, under 120ms. Best for dark tools and sites with 10 to 15 links.

Actions sit above the links: two 48px pills or one 44px button directly under the header, then 16 to 20px rows on 57 to 77px pitch with arrows or chevrons. Use when most phone visitors came to sign up.

Links as headline: 40 to 64px display type, tracking -.03 to -.045em, 44 to 66px pitch, no rows or icons, left aligned, filling the screen from the top. Base: a hairline, then small account links. Reveal with a fast clip or fade. Six short words at most.

The menu is a room of brand colour: full-screen flat fill, 28 to 44px links, small secondary links below, close mark in place of the burger. Entered by a wash or stacked bands, 120 to 900ms. Spend it once on a page.

Numbered rows: 01 to 06 in 10 to 12px beside 32 to 56px heavy or serif links, 60 to 97px pitch, hairlines, an optional one-line subtitle, language or clock pinned at the base. Reads like a contents page. For agencies and hotels.

A curved mask sweeps down, then 38 to 44px serif links fade in from the top on 57 to 80px pitch, with hairlines, circled arrows and one full-width CTA. 320ms sweep, stagger to 900ms. Uses clip-path, so drop it under reduced motion.

The menu is a card under the bar: 8 to 16px side inset, radius 12 to 16, rows at 16/600 on 48 to 60px pitch, CTAs inside, page blurred 8px behind. Lighter than a takeover. Floating bars expand into it. Cap its height and let it scroll.

Menu opens in the flow: rows drop under the header and push the hero down, 40 to 57px pitch, hairlines, no scrim, complete by 120ms. Simple and robust, with no scroll lock. Best for short lists of four to six.

A sheet from the right at 80 to 100 percent width over a scrim, 200 to 320ms ease-out: 16 to 17px rows on 48 to 53px pitch, chevrons, hairlines, empty middle, CTAs pinned at the base. Keep a 30 to 60px peek of the page so it reads as a layer.

Left drawer or inline panel holding the same tree as desktop docs: 14 to 15px rows on 32 to 36px pitch, caps group labels, active row tinted, scrolled to the current page. Keeps the reader's place rather than offering a marketing list.

Rows carry more than a name: 106px tinted cards with title, line and illustration, or 44px icon tiles with descriptions on 80px pitch, or chip grids by section. Then plain links, then CTAs at the base. For products whose names alone do not sell.

No panel: full-width pills pop in one at a time over the live page, 60 to 80px tall, 8 to 16px gaps, centred labels. Playful and easy on the thumb. Four items only. Stagger 60 to 100ms with a slight scale.

Search leads: a 44 to 56px field at the top of the sheet, focused, then quick links with arrows, or tabs for docs, guides and reference. For stores and docs where visitors know what they want. Keep results in the same sheet.

Menu anchored low: 30px links on 40px pitch in the lower half with chevrons far right, or a rounded-top sheet with close controls at its base. Everything sits in thumb reach, and the empty space above is fine.

Sticky 222 to 300px left column on long pages: 15px links on 27 to 28px pitch, 15/600 group heads, active in accent or with a 2px tick hung outside. List masks out over 64px at the base above a hairline and one pinned link.

Fixed 80 to 92px left rail bounded by a full-height 1px line: a tall monogram at top, Menu at the base, nothing between. Content scrolls right of the line. Reads as a printed margin. App version: 88px rail, 24px icons on 72px steps, active pill.

A fixed 200 to 300px column replaces the top bar: logo, 6 to 20 plain links at 15 to 20px, no active chrome, actions pinned to the base, 1px rule or none. Content scrolls beside it. For tools, libraries and indexes.
Site sections as desktop files: 56px illustrated icons with 13 to 14px shadowed labels in columns at both edges on an 84px pitch, over a wallpaper. A whole-site metaphor, never a garnish.

Navigation held on the frame: rotated 14px labels at mid height 57px from each edge, fixed monogram letters at 50px insets, or small margin notes. Ink recolours per section. For architecture and portfolios with few pages.

A small index on the side: 12 to 16px numbers or ticks on 14 to 39px pitch, active one ringed, bracketed or longer, neighbours fading by distance, keyboard hints optional. Reads as a contact sheet or picker wheel. For decks and scroll stories.

A band of tabs under the main nav for parts of one thing: 40 to 58px, 11 to 14px tracked caps or text, active underline, sticky. Brand fill for restaurant menus, hairline for museums, 40px product thumbnails for ranges.

A tab fixed to the viewport edge: 40 to 52px wide, 198 to 270px tall, 12 to 18px rotated or stacked label, inner corners radius 8. One persistent job such as hours or shop. Vertical scripts make it natural.

Navigation placed in the page as a list: 36/40 links in a 700px column on 101px pitch, 1px rules, no icons, an Index label at left. Or a chapter list at 17/25 on each opener. For sites that read like a book.
App or docs tree: 13 to 14px rows on 29 to 32px pitch, 12px caps labels, active row a flat tint at radius 2 to 8 with a 2 to 3px accent bar, children indented 22px on a guide line.

Fixed 288px rail: 12px mono caps group labels tracked .1em, 14px links on 32px pitch indented 16px behind a 1px line, active link 500 with an ink segment on the line, 32px between groups. No icons, no chevrons, every page visible.

300px rail, 1px rule: 36px filter field with a slash keycap, 12px caps labels, 14px rows on 34px pitch, line icons, right chevrons, active row tinted at radius 8. Filtering narrows the tree. For docs with hundreds of pages. Can float as a panel inset 8px.

Wide 300 to 348px column: 15px section heads with 18px outline icons, children 14px muted on 33px pitch flush with the icon, not indented, chevrons far right, active in accent with no fill. Or nine flat top links, a divider, then collapsible groups.

240 to 260px rail, 14px rows on 32 to 37px pitch, active row a soft filled pill at radius 8 to 999 with darker text, 13 to 14px group labels, no guide lines. Soft and product-like. Fade the rail at top and bottom.

Docs layout: 48 to 56px top bar, 260 to 304px left rail, 576 to 730px reading column, 200 to 240px right outline. Rails fixed, only content scrolls. Content sits off-centre to keep a 65 character measure.

Right outline: 13 to 14px grey links on 28 to 32px pitch beside a 1px line, nested items indented 12px, current heading turns ink with a dark segment on the line. Starts level with the page title. Hidden on narrow screens.
Three-level docs: top bar, a 44 to 48px row of product tabs at 13 to 14px with a 1px accent underline on a hairline, then left rail and right outline. For docs that span several products.
Docs home as an index, not a tree: grouped cards or a plain grid, each entry an 8px colour square, 16/600 name and 12 to 13px grey line. Everything visible at a glance. Empty cells stay empty.
Contents page of a book: 18/500 chapter titles, 3px dotted leader to a right-aligned 14px page number, 50px pitch. Use once, for handbooks and long reads.
Header built for reading: 44 to 65px, 13px breadcrumb, copy-page button, search with slash key, plan or version switch, split into cells by 1px rules or quiet spacing. Utilities only, no marketing.
Horizontal filter for lists such as changelogs: 15px text filters in muted ink, 16px gaps, active just brightens with no pill, 280x40 pill search at right with a bare subscribe bell.
